summary: 8 acceptance criteria exercised via 3 backend test files (4 tests) + 6 browser checks. All passed.

checks.criterion: Role permissions membedakan Super Admin dan Reviewer
checks.name: test_tscheck_role_permissions.py
checks.evidence: PATCH /api/admin/lots/{id}?admin_role=reviewer -> 403 'Aksi ini hanya tersedia untuk Super Admin'; PATCH ...?admin_role=super_admin -> 200 with updated lot.

checks.criterion: Role permissions membedakan Super Admin dan Reviewer
checks.name: admin-role-restricts-reviewer
checks.evidence: On /admin, Super Admin shows admin-lots-section + admin-winners-section; switching to Reviewer via admin-role-bar hides admin-lots-section (count 0) and shows reviewer-restriction-card.

checks.criterion: Registrasi bidder mendukung upload dokumen nyata dan auto screening
checks.name: register-full-flow-completes-screening
checks.evidence: Filled /register individual form incl. real PDF upload via setInputFiles; registration-success-card shows registration-status-value=PENDING and registration-screening-value contains READY.

checks.criterion: Peserta tidak lengkap tidak masuk antrean review
checks.name: test_tscheck_incomplete_not_queued.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/buyers/register without documents -> 201 verification_status=INCOMPLETE, screening_status=INCOMPLETE; GET /api/admin/buyers?status=PENDING does not include the new buyer id.

checks.name: approvals-approve-pending-buyer
checks.evidence: Fixture buyer registered+doc uploaded via API (PENDING/READY), row visible on /admin/approvals, clicking Setujui removes the row (count 0) and GET /api/buyers/{id} confirms verification_status=APPROVED.

checks.name: approvals-reject-requires-reason
checks.evidence: Reject button disabled with empty/<'bad' 3-char reason, enabled after 5+ char reason; click sets REJECTED and GET /api/buyers/{id} shows review_reason='Dokumen identitas tidak sesuai'.

checks.name: approvals-approve-pending-buyer
checks.evidence: admin-audit-list on /admin/approvals contains the approved buyer's full name after the decision (also verified reject reason text in approvals-reject-requires-reason).

checks.name: dashboard-shows-approval-banner
checks.evidence: Fixture buyer registered/uploaded/rejected via API, localStorage bidder set to matching full_name, /dashboard shows dashboard-verification-alert-title='Verifikasi ditolak' and reason text 'Alamat tidak sesuai dokumen'.

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_document_download.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/buyers/{id}/documents (PDF bytes) then GET /api/admin/buyers/{id}/documents/{doc_id}?admin_role=reviewer -> 200, content-type application/pdf, body bytes match uploaded fixture.

notes: Matrix has 8 criteria; 9 artifacts were produced because 'Audit log menyimpan keputusan lengkap' is covered by the same browser checks that exercise approve/reject (no separate flow needed).
Admin auth is intentionally MOCKED per spec_deviations (role chosen via UI/localStorage, backend enforces via admin_role query param) - this matches the briefing and is not a bug.
